name: neon-sign
title: Neon Sign
description: A neon tube sign on a brick or dark wall, for a status read at a glance: on air, open, recording. Each letter is a tube of tinted glass that strikes with a flicker when the sign turns on, then glows steady, casting its colour on the wall, with a rare buzz on one letter; reduced motion fades it on and never buzzes. A status named by its label, with turnOn and turnOff for agents. Tilt Neon from npm (OFL-1.1).

docs: `<NeonSign label text sub color subColor wall on|defaultOn onOnChange buzz labels>`. `color` and `subColor` are tube colours: `pink` (the default), `red`, `orange`, `green`, `blue`, `cyan`, `violet` or `white`; `wall` is `brick` (the default) or `dark`. The root is a `status` named by `label` whose text is the sign's words, followed by `labels.off` while dark, so a change is announced politely. Turning it on plays the strike (`data-striking` until it ends); `buzz` dims one random letter for 300 ms every few seconds while lit, on a timer that stops off screen, in a hidden tab and under reduced motion. Everything moves in CSS opacity; nothing runs between flickers. The wall, the acrylic backboard and the tubes are the item's `css`, which also imports `@fontsource-variable/tilt-neon`.
